_meta.type: build -- produces a real backtest, not a read
_meta.branched_from_note: R0's t0a2_prior_close.parquet is a direct input (move_at needs it). R0's scoping findings are background, not gates on this work, per the brief.
carried_forward_non_negotiable: move_at (causal) is the only move measure. momentum_pct enters no threshold, score or slice.
PF = 1.9194 is not ground truth and is not validated against. Built fresh.

facet1_entry_exit.choice: use the existing fired population as-is
facet1_entry_exit.choice_rationale: The brief allows either. Re-running the gate causally against all of D1 is not a small lift -- it means executing or re-implementing epg_replay.py's Hawkes refit over ~15,763 events. The existing population is on disk with full per-trade records.
facet1_entry_exit.source_note: The largest gate run in this checkout that carries a per-trade record. READ-ONLY; nothing under scanner-epg-momentum is executed, imported or modified.
facet1_entry_exit.first_window_rule: entry_type == 'first', then the earliest entry_ts per (ticker, date). 'first' marks the first entry of EACH pass window, so an event has several; the brief's 'first window only' is the earliest of them.
facet1_entry_exit.exit_primary: natural_exit_* -- the window-close exit, i.e. the exit the trade would have taken without EXIT_D/LULD early exits
facet1_entry_exit.exit_secondary: exit_* -- the exit actually realized in that run. Reported alongside, never instead.
facet1_entry_exit.exit_note: The brief specifies window-close exit. natural_exit_reason on the first window is epg_window_close for 860 of 1,027; the other 167 are LULD exits and are carried, not dropped.
facet1_entry_exit.pnl_is_gross_check: pnl_pct == (exit_price/entry_price - 1) * 100 to 2.8e-14. The gate applies no cost or slippage model: config/strategy.json carries epg, hawkes, exit_d, luld and gap_gate blocks and no fee block.

score_v0.name: relative_volume
score_v0.formula: dollar volume of all prints in [tau - W, tau] divided by B_e
score_v0.causal: the window ends at tau and opens backward. No print after tau enters it, asserted in code.

baseline.name: B_e
baseline.source_status: UNCOMMITTED on explore/fundamental-e1 and still uncommitted here. Recorded, not resolved.
baseline.definition_as_inferred: total_baseline_dollar_volume / 117 on every row checked; 117 = 3 sessions x 39 ten-minute blocks per 6.5-hour RTH session. So B_e is mean dollar volume per 10-minute RTH block over 3 prior sessions.

gate_1_level.rule: score >= the 75th percentile of the score's own distribution across all candidate moments
gate_1_level.note: A round, defensible v0 default declared by the brief. Not fitted. The percentile is taken over the candidate moments in this population, so it is in-sample by construction -- stated, not hidden.

gate_2_cross_section.rule: score is the highest among all candidates whose gate window is concurrently live at that same moment
gate_2_cross_section.liveness: [entry_ts, natural_exit_ts] of each candidate's own first window -- the gate's own window-close definition
gate_2_cross_section.singleton_behaviour: a candidate alone in its live set passes gate 2 trivially. Reported as its own class, never silently pooled.

policies.B: EPG+Qual -- only signals passing both qualification gates

cost.source: results/phase_11/REPORT.md:72 -- median round-trip cost in the named cell
cost.rationale: The gate has no native fill or cost model to prefer over it (see facet1_entry_exit.pnl_is_gross_check), so there is no 'whichever fits better' choice to make. Both units are applied and both are reported (D19).
cost.caveat: Phase 11's figure is a median effective-spread round trip measured at the detection anchor on an RTH cell, not at these entry instants. It is a scalar stand-in, not a per-trade cost model.

diagnostic.name: score vs move_at collinearity
diagnostic.move_at_formula: (entry_price - prior_close) / prior_close at the candidate moment
diagnostic.a12: move_at is a cross-session ratio; flag_cross_session_extreme is carried and headline splits are reported with and without it, untrimmed first.

constraints.d4: tick-derived only. No spine numeric column enters any computed quantity.
constraints.d5: long-only. No short or fade variant is specified, implemented or measured.
constraints.coverage: flag and carry coverage gaps, never drop. State population coverage plainly rather than assume it equals D1.

chart_theme.note: Light theme and the results-tree chart location, matching E1's precedent and R0's.
